_comment: Merge these blocks into your .claude/settings.json (project) or ~/.claude/settings.json (user-global). Adjust the absolute path to context-zone.sh. Thresholds are fixed TOKEN amounts (not percentages of any marketed/API window); they are calibrated on empirical behavior cliffs and apply identically on Codex's current 258.4k effective window, Claude Code 200k models (Sonnet 4.6 / Haiku 4.5), and Opus 4.7's 1M window. Only the percentage that appears in the nudge message is computed against REFERENCE_WINDOW (default 200k), so it matches the percentage-talk people are used to.
